summary.headline: Planetary Signification of Wars
summary.text: Chapters 25–26 of Māshāʾallāh’s astrological work discuss planetary motion in judging wars, the army lord’s dignity, diurnal and nocturnal planets, and the king’s significator entering combustion and predicting his death.
